name: top-p includes the threshold-crossing token and respects an exact boundary
input: probabilities [0.5, 0.25, 0.25]: p=0.5 keeps ID 0; p=0.6 adds ID 1
test:
import torch
torch.set_default_dtype(torch.float64)
torch.manual_seed(110)
logits = torch.tensor([0.5, 0.25, 0.25]).log()
assert all((top_p_sample(torch.as_tensor(logits, dtype=torch.float64), 0.5) == 0 for _ in range(20)))
assert set((top_p_sample(torch.as_tensor(logits, dtype=torch.float64), 0.6) for _ in range(200))) == {0, 1}
assert set((sample_token(torch.as_tensor(logits, dtype=torch.float64), top_k=3, top_p=0.6) for _ in range(200))) == {0, 1}
print('ok')

name: large common offsets and strided tensors do not mutate inputs
input: large logits on a noncontiguous PyTorch tensor
test:
import torch
torch.set_default_dtype(torch.float64)
storage = torch.tensor([10003.0, -999.0, 10000.0, -998.0, 9999.0, -997.0])
logits = storage[::2]
before = storage.clone()
values = torch.tensor([10003.0, 10000.0, 9999.0], requires_grad=True)
original = values.detach().clone()
for _ in range(20):
    assert sample_token(torch.as_tensor(logits, dtype=torch.float64), top_k=2, top_p=0.6) == 0
    assert top_k_sample(torch.as_tensor(values, dtype=torch.float64), 1) == 0
    assert top_p_sample(torch.as_tensor(values, dtype=torch.float64), 0.6) == 0
assert torch.equal(storage, before)
assert torch.equal(values, original)
print('ok')

name: finite extreme logits and temperatures preserve the distribution
input: logits [1e308, -1e308] with temperature=1e308; tied huge logits with a tiny temperature
test:
import torch
torch.set_default_dtype(torch.float64)
torch.manual_seed(111)
samples = [sample_token(torch.as_tensor([1e+308, -1e+308], dtype=torch.float64), temperature=1e+308) for _ in range(6000)]
expected = 1.0 / (1.0 + torch.tensor(-2.0).exp())
assert set(samples) == {0, 1}
assert abs(samples.count(0) / len(samples) - expected) < 0.04
assert set((sample_token(torch.as_tensor([1e+308, 1e+308, -1e+308], dtype=torch.float64), top_p=0.9, temperature=1e-300) for _ in range(200))) == {0, 1}
print('ok')
